name: Gordok Commons
summary: In the Gordok Commons, King Gordok rules the Gordunni’s northern stronghold in Dire Maul.

sections.title: Seat of the Ogre King
sections.body: The Gordok Commons fill an old aristocratic wing of Eldre'Thalas. The ogres have remade its night elven pillars and arched passages for their own needs. Armories, crude barricades, and training grounds crowd the halls. Here the Gordok train, the fiercest and most disciplined fighters in the Gordunni clan. At the far end, King Gordok holds court at Gordok's Seat and rules through force and fear.

sections.title: Law of Succession
sections.body: Among the Gordunni, might decides who rules. By clan tradition, whoever slays the sitting monarch takes the title of King Gordok and wins the obedience of the surviving captains and guards. A challenger may slip past the king's lieutenants through stealth or guile. If the challenger kills only the king, the guards accept the victor's authority and bring lavish tributes instead of avenging their former ruler.

faq.q: Where is the Gordok Commons located?
faq.answer: The Gordok Commons fill Dire Maul's northern quarter in Feralas. Enter the ruin through the Broken Commons, then follow the massive stone corridors to the northern entrance.

The Gordok are the elite warrior caste of the Gordunni ogre clan. Their kin roam the Feralas wilderness in scattered, feral bands, while the Gordok in the Commons are organized, heavily armed, and obey a strict chain of command under their king.

faq.q: How does ogre leadership work in the Commons?
aliases: how to become king of gordok
faq.answer: Combat decides who rules the Gordok. Whoever kills the reigning King Gordok claims the crown, and the remaining ogres submit to their new sovereign.

faq.q: Why do adventurers leave the ogre guards alive?
faq.answer: When an intruder defeats King Gordok and leaves his lieutenants alive, the commanders submit to the new king. The garrison brings valuable tribute to whoever claims the throne directly.

angles.text: As an engineer, you can help Knot Thimblejack, the goblin prisoner, scavenge supplies, mend broken traps, and devise clever distractions against the ogre guards.
